# Component attributes

Every attribute each element of a component takes, with the values AnimeLogon accepts for it. Any attribute other than `label` may instead be `$id`, the value of one of the component's settings (see [component-format.md](component-format.md)).

- **Default**: the value when the attribute is not written.
- **Adjustable**: whether the AnimeLogon app lets the user adjust it on this element alone, and a theme can set it with an adjustment key such as `p1.l1.t1.weight`.
- **em**: the panel's `size`. A text of `size="0.5"` is half the panel's em.

## `<panel>`

| Attribute | Value | Default | Adjustable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | 1 to 40 characters | — | no | The panel's name in the AnimeLogon app's list of parts. Not shown on the lock screen. |
| `anchor` | `top-left` `top` `top-right` `left` `center` `right` `bottom-left` `bottom` `bottom-right` | `top` | yes | Where on the display the panel is placed. |
| `size` | number, 1 to 50 | `10` | yes | The panel's em: the size of its text, in percent of the display's height. Every length in em within the panel follows it. |
| `margin` | number, 0 to 40 | `7` | yes | Distance from the display edges the anchor is next to, in percent of the display's shorter side. |
| `offset-x` | number, -50 to 50 | `0` | yes | Moves the panel right, or left when negative, in percent of the display's width. |
| `offset-y` | number, -50 to 50 | `0` | yes | Moves the panel down, or up when negative, in percent of the display's height. |
| `align` | `auto` `left` `center` `right` | `auto` | yes | How the panel's lines line up with each other. `auto` follows the anchor's column. |
| `when` | [condition](component-format.md#conditions) | — | no | Draws the panel only while the condition holds. |
| `until` | `YYYY-MM-DD` | — | no | The date the `until.*` data counts down to. |
| `enter` | `fade` `rise` `zoom` `none` | `fade` | yes | How the panel comes in when the lock screen appears: fades in, rises 0.35 em while fading in, grows from 90% while fading in, or appears at once. |
| `enter-delay` | number, 0 to 10 | `0` | yes | Seconds after the wallpaper appears before the panel comes in. |
| `enter-duration` | number, 0 to 5 | `0.4` | yes | Seconds the panel takes to come in. |
| `opacity` | number, 0 to 1 | `1` | yes | Opacity of everything the panel draws. |

## `<line>`

| Attribute | Value | Default | Adjustable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | 1 to 40 characters | — | no | A name for the author's own reference. Nothing shows it. |
| `gap` | number, -2 to 4 | `0.2` | yes | Distance from the previous line's baseline to the top of this line's ink, in em. |
| `when` | [condition](component-format.md#conditions) | — | no | Draws the line only while the condition holds. |
| `show` | `true` `false` | `true` | yes | `false` leaves the line out, as if it were not written. Usually bound to a toggle. |

## `<text>`

| Attribute | Value | Default | Adjustable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | 1 to 40 characters | — | no | The text's name in the AnimeLogon app's list of parts. Without one, the AnimeLogon app names it after the data it shows. |
| `value` | words and `{data}`, up to 256 characters | — | no | What the text shows: words, and data names in braces, such as `{battery.percent}%`. |
| `when` | [condition](component-format.md#conditions) | — | no | Draws the text only while the condition holds. |
| `font` | font family, or empty | — | yes | A font family. Empty, or a font the PC lacks: Segoe UI Variable Display, or Segoe UI. Only fonts installed for all users are available to the lock screen. |
| `size` | number, 0.05 to 4 | `1` | yes | Size relative to the panel's em. |
| `weight` | 1 to 999, or `thin` `extralight` `light` `regular` `medium` `semibold` `bold` `extrabold` `black` | `400` | yes | Font weight. The nearest weight the font has is used. |
| `style` | `normal` `italic` | `normal` | yes | Upright or italic. |
| `color` | `#RRGGBB` or `#RRGGBBAA` | `#FFFFFF` | yes | Text colour. |
| `opacity` | number, 0 to 1 | `1` | yes | Text opacity. |
| `tracking` | number, -0.5 to 1 | `0` | yes | Extra space between characters, in em of this text's own size. |
| `space` | number, 0 to 4 | `0` | yes | Space before this item on its line, in em. Ignored for the first item drawn on the line. |
| `case` | `none` `upper` `lower` | `none` | yes | Upper or lower case for Latin letters. |
| `hang` | `true` `false` | `false` | yes | `true` keeps the text beside the others but out of the alignment of the panel's lines, as the clock's AM/PM. The AnimeLogon app offers this choice only on texts that write `hang`. |
| `show` | `true` `false` | `true` | yes | `false` leaves the text out; it takes no room. Usually bound to a toggle. |
| `rise` | number, -1 to 1 | `0` | yes | Raises the text above the line's baseline, or lowers it when negative, in em. |
| `max` | number, 0 to 40 | `0` | yes | The widest the text may be, in em; longer text ends in an ellipsis. 0: no limit. |
| `figures` | `proportional` `tabular` | `proportional` | yes | `tabular` gives every digit the same width, so changing numbers keep their width. |

## `<bar>`

| Attribute | Value | Default | Adjustable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | 1 to 40 characters | — | no | The bar's name in the AnimeLogon app's list of parts. |
| `value` | `{battery.level}` `{media.progress}` | — | no | The fraction from 0 to 1 the bar shows: one data name in braces. |
| `when` | [condition](component-format.md#conditions) | — | no | Draws the bar only while the condition holds. |
| `length` | number, 0.2 to 40 | `6` | yes | Length in em. |
| `thickness` | number, 0.02 to 1 | `0.12` | yes | Thickness in em. |
| `radius` | number, 0 to 0.5 | `0.5` | yes | Corner radius as a share of the thickness: 0 square, 0.5 fully round ends. |
| `color` | `#RRGGBB` or `#RRGGBBAA` | `#FFFFFF` | yes | Colour of the filled part. |
| `opacity` | number, 0 to 1 | `1` | yes | Opacity of the filled part. |
| `track` | `#RRGGBB` or `#RRGGBBAA` | `#FFFFFF` | yes | Colour of the part not yet filled. |
| `track-opacity` | number, 0 to 1 | `0.25` | yes | Opacity of the part not yet filled. 0 hides it. |
| `space` | number, 0 to 4 | `0` | yes | Space before the bar on its line, in em. Ignored for the first item drawn on the line. |
| `show` | `true` `false` | `true` | yes | `false` leaves the bar out; it takes no room. |

## `<spectrum>`

| Attribute | Value | Default | Adjustable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | 1 to 40 characters | — | no | The spectrum's name in the AnimeLogon app's list of parts. |
| `when` | [condition](component-format.md#conditions) | — | no | Draws the spectrum only while the condition holds. |
| `mode` | `bars` `line` `area` | `bars` | yes | Bars, a line through the bands' tops, or the area under that line. |
| `direction` | `up` `down` `both` | `up` | yes | Which way the bands reach: up, down, or both ways from the middle. |
| `bass` | `left` `right` `middle` | `left` | yes | Where the low frequencies are: left, right, or in the middle with the treble at both ends. |
| `length` | number, 0.5 to 80 | `12` | yes | Width in em. |
| `height` | number, 0.05 to 8 | `1` | yes | How far a band can reach, in em. |
| `bands` | whole number, 4 to 128 | `64` | yes | Number of frequency bands. |
| `gap` | number, 0 to 0.95 | `0.35` | yes | Space between bars, as a share of each band's width. |
| `radius` | number, 0 to 0.5 | `0.5` | yes | Corner radius of a bar, as a share of its width: 0 square, 0.5 fully round. |
| `stroke` | number, 0.005 to 1 | `0.06` | yes | Width of the line, in em (`line` and `area`). |
| `floor` | number, 0 to 1 | `0.05` | yes | Height of a band at rest, as a share of `height`. |
| `colors` | [colour stops](component-format.md#colour-stops) | `#FFFFFF 0%` | yes | The colours along the gradient. One colour is a plain colour. |
| `flow` | number, 0 to 60 | `0` | yes | Seconds for the colours to slide along the gradient and back. 0: still. |
| `gradient` | `horizontal` `vertical` `level` | `horizontal` | yes | Left to right, from where the bands start to where they reach, or each bar in the colour its height reads off the gradient. |
| `opacity` | number, 0 to 1 | `1` | yes | Opacity of the spectrum. |
| `idle-opacity` | number, 0 to 1 | `1` | yes | Opacity while nothing is heard, times `opacity`. 0 hides the spectrum in silence. |
| `peak` | number, 0 to 1 | `0` | yes | Opacity of a mark held briefly above each bar, times `opacity`. 0: no marks. |
| `sensitivity` | number, 0.05 to 10 | `1` | yes | Higher values make quiet sound reach higher. |
| `smoothing` | number, 0 to 0.99 | `0.5` | yes | Higher values make the bands rise and fall more slowly. |
| `low` | number, 10 to 20000 | `40` | yes | Lowest frequency shown, in Hz. |
| `high` | number, 20 to 24000 | `16000` | yes | Highest frequency shown, in Hz. Below 1.5 times `low`, it is taken as twice `low`. |
| `space` | number, 0 to 4 | `0` | yes | Space before the spectrum on its line, in em. Ignored for the first item drawn on the line. |
| `show` | `true` `false` | `true` | yes | `false` leaves the spectrum out; it takes no room. |

## `<shadow>`

| Attribute | Value | Default | Adjustable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | 1 to 40 characters | — | no | The shadow's name in the AnimeLogon app's list of parts. |
| `blur` | number, 0 to 1 | `0.1` | yes | Blur radius in em. |
| `opacity` | number, 0 to 1 | `0.3` | yes | Shadow opacity. 0 draws no shadow. |
| `x` | number, -1 to 1 | `0` | yes | Moves the shadow right, or left when negative, in em. |
| `y` | number, -1 to 1 | `0` | yes | Moves the shadow down, or up when negative, in em. |
| `color` | `#RRGGBB` or `#RRGGBBAA` | `#000000` | yes | Shadow colour. |

## `<backdrop>`

| Attribute | Value | Default | Adjustable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | 1 to 40 characters | — | no | The backdrop's name in the AnimeLogon app's list of parts. |
| `opacity` | number, 0 to 1 | `0` | yes | Opacity of what is drawn behind the panel's ink. 0 draws nothing. |
| `color` | `#RRGGBB` or `#RRGGBBAA` | `#000000` | yes | Backdrop colour. |
| `shape` | `glow` `plate` | `glow` | yes | A soft glow that fades out around the ink, or a plate with rounded corners. |
| `radius` | number, 0 to 4 | `0.35` | yes | Corner radius of a plate, in em. |
| `padding-x` | number, 0 to 4 | `0.6` | yes | Space from the ink to a plate's left and right edges, in em. |
| `padding-y` | number, 0 to 4 | `0.4` | yes | Space from the ink to a plate's top and bottom edges, in em. |

## Data

Names a text's `value` can hold in braces (`text`), a bar's `value` (`fraction`), and a condition (any kind; only a `state` can be compared with `=` and `!=`). Words are in the language of the clock settings: Chinese, Japanese or English.

| Name | Kind | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `time` | text | — | The time in the regional format, in 12 or 24 hours as AnimeLogon's clock settings say, without the AM/PM marker. |
| `ampm` | text | — | The AM/PM marker while the time is in 12 hours and the marker is on; otherwise empty. |
| `date` | text | — | The date in the clock settings' date style: the weekday and date without the year, or the long date. |
| `date.long` | text | — | The regional format's long date. |
| `weekday` | text | — | The day of the week. |
| `month` | text | — | The name of the month. |
| `day` | text | — | The day of the month. |
| `year` | text | — | The year. |
| `battery.percent` | text | — | The charge, 0 to 100, without a percent sign. Empty without a battery. |
| `battery.remaining` | text | — | Time left on the battery as h:mm, while discharging and Windows has an estimate. |
| `battery.remaining.long` | text | — | The same in words, such as 3 hr 25 min. |
| `battery.status` | text | — | "Charging" or "Plugged in" while on mains power; empty on battery or without one. |
| `battery.glyph` | text | — | A battery icon for the charge and whether it charges. Draw it with `font="Segoe Fluent Icons"`. |
| `battery.level` | fraction | — | The charge as a fraction, for a bar. |
| `battery.state` | state | `none` `charging` `discharging` `plugged` | `plugged` is on mains power and not charging: full, or held by a charge limit. |
| `power.source` | state | `none` `battery` `mains` | `mains` is plugged in, or a PC without a battery; `none`: Windows cannot tell. |
| `power.status` | text | — | "AC power" or "On battery"; empty when Windows cannot tell. |
| `media.title` | text | — | The title of what plays in the signed-in user's session. |
| `media.artist` | text | — | Its artist. |
| `media.album` | text | — | Its album. |
| `media.app` | text | — | The app playing it. |
| `media.position` | text | — | How far it has played, m:ss or h:mm:ss. |
| `media.duration` | text | — | Its length, m:ss or h:mm:ss. Empty when unknown. |
| `media.glyph` | text | — | A solid play or pause icon. Draw it with `font="Segoe Fluent Icons"`. |
| `media.status` | text | — | "Playing", "Paused" or "Not playing". The only media data with a value while nothing plays. |
| `media.progress` | fraction | — | How far it has played, as a fraction of its length, for a bar. |
| `media.state` | state | `none` `playing` `paused` | Whether something plays. |
| `until.days` | text | — | Days from today to the panel's `until` date, while it is ahead. |
| `until.prefix` | text | — | The word before the number, in the clock's language ("还有", "あと"; nothing in English), while the date is ahead. |
| `until.unit` | text | — | The word after the number ("days", "day"), while the date is ahead. |
| `until.today` | text | — | "Today", on the date itself. |
| `until.state` | state | `none` `ahead` `today` `past` | Where the panel's `until` date is: `none` when the panel has none. |

## Limits

| What | At most |
|---|---|
| Component file | 64 KB, UTF-8 |
| Elements in the file | 256 |
| Nesting | 4 levels: `<component>` `<panel>` `<line>` `<text>` |
| Attributes on one element | 32 |
| Characters in one attribute value | 512 |
| Settings | 32 |
| Options of one `<choice>` | 32 |
| Characters in a setting id | 32 |
| Characters in a `name`, `author` or `label` | 40 |
| Characters in a `detail` | 80 |
| Panels | 8 |
| Lines in one panel | 8 |
| Texts, bars and spectra in one line | 8 |
| Shadows in one panel | 4, and one backdrop |
| Components in one theme, hidden ones included | 8 |
| `<set>` elements for one component in a theme | 128 |
| Component files in one theme package | 8 |
